prompt: Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT. Create ONE alternate studio catalog photograph of THAT EXACT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: small display box with an empty recessed front niche and woven external panels over a wood structure, unlit; right side thick woven wall, rear a plain removable panel. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. All interiors empty. Preserve natural product pose, including open lid state. CAMERA: exact RIGHT SIDE: orbit camera 90 degrees to object's right from canonical front, matching elevation. Front face edge-on, show right profile. Preserve exact shape, frame, color, weave, number and locations of compartments, handles, legs, ribs, hinges and secondary materials. Reveal previously hidden surfaces consistently. Do not redesign, mirror or repeat front camera. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
